import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
const { chromium, webkit } = await import(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE);
const out = process.env.QA_OUTPUT;
await fs.mkdir(out, { recursive: true });
const report = { checks: [], failures: [], layouts: [], transitionSamples: [] };
const base = 'http://127.0.0.1:4173';
const target = '.about-page [data-about-reveal]';
const pending = '.about-page [data-about-reveal-state="pending"]';

function instrumentation() {
  window.__motionStarts = [];
  window.__motionObservers = [];
  const OriginalObserver = window.IntersectionObserver;
  window.IntersectionObserver = class extends OriginalObserver {
    constructor(callback, options) {
      super(callback, options);
      this.record = { active: new Set(), about: false };
      window.__motionObservers.push(this.record);
    }
    observe(node) {
      this.record.active.add(node);
      if (node.closest('.about-page')) this.record.about = true;
      super.observe(node);
    }
    unobserve(node) { this.record.active.delete(node); super.unobserve(node); }
    disconnect() { this.record.active.clear(); super.disconnect(); }
  };
  document.addEventListener('transitionstart', (event) => {
    if (event.propertyName === 'transform' && event.target.matches('[data-about-reveal]')) {
      window.__motionStarts.push({ className: event.target.className, time: performance.now() });
    }
  });
}
async function ready(page, url = `${base}/about`) {
  await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' });
  await page.locator('.about-page').waitFor();
  await page.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
  await page.locator('.about-page img').evaluateAll((images) => images.forEach((image) => { image.loading = 'eager'; }));
  await page.waitForFunction(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.about-page img')].every((image) => image.complete && image.naturalWidth > 0));
}
async function finish(page) {
  await page.waitForFunction(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.about-page [data-about-reveal]')].every((el) => el.dataset.aboutRevealState !== 'pending' && Number(getComputedStyle(el).opacity) === 1 && getComputedStyle(el).transform === 'none'));
  await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('.about-page').getAnimations({ subtree: true }).every((animation) => animation.playState === 'finished'));
}
async function sweep(page) {
  const dimensions = await page.evaluate(() => ({ height: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, viewport: innerHeight }));
  for (let y = 0; y < dimensions.height; y += Math.round(dimensions.viewport * 0.65)) {
    await page.evaluate((top) => window.scrollTo({ top, behavior: 'instant' }), y);
    await page.waitForTimeout(90);
    assert(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= document.documentElement.clientWidth + 1), 'no horizontal overflow while revealing');
  }
  await finish(page);
  await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' }));
}
async function visibleSnapshot(page) {
  return page.locator(target).evaluateAll((nodes) => nodes.map((el) => ({
    state: el.dataset.aboutRevealState, opacity: getComputedStyle(el).opacity,
    transform: getComputedStyle(el).transform, duration: getComputedStyle(el).transitionDuration,
    delay: getComputedStyle(el).transitionDelay,
  })));
}

for (const [name, engine] of Object.entries({ chromium, webkit })) {
  const browser = await engine.launch();
  let page;
  const runtimeErrors = [];
  const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 }, reducedMotion: 'no-preference' });
  await context.addInitScript(instrumentation);
  page = await context.newPage();
  page.setDefaultTimeout(12000);
  page.on('pageerror', (error) => runtimeErrors.push(String(error)));
  try {
    // Inspect a real intermediate transition, not just final revealed classes.
    await ready(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator(target).count(), 24, 'all planned targets found');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.our-values__card').first().getAttribute('data-about-reveal-state'), 'pending');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.our-values__card').first().evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity), '0');
    await page.locator('.our-values__grid').evaluate((el) => {
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      window.scrollTo({ top: scrollY + rect.top - 150, behavior: 'instant' });
    });
    await page.waitForFunction(() => {
      const el = document.querySelector('.our-values__card');
      const opacity = Number(getComputedStyle(el).opacity);
      return el.dataset.aboutRevealState === 'visible' && opacity > 0.05 && opacity < 0.98;
    });
    const sample = await page.locator('.our-values__card').evaluateAll((nodes) => nodes.map((el) => ({ opacity: getComputedStyle(el).opacity, transform: getComputedStyle(el).transform, delay: getComputedStyle(el).transitionDelay, duration: getComputedStyle(el).transitionDuration })));
    assert(sample.some((item) => Number(item.opacity) > 0 && Number(item.opacity) < 1), 'actual fade in progress');
    assert(sample.some((item) => item.transform !== 'none'), 'actual movement in progress');
    assert.deepEqual(sample.map((item) => item.delay), ['0s', '0.08s', '0.16s']);
    report.transitionSamples.push({ browser: name, sample });
    await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${name}-values-in-motion.png`), animations: 'allow' });
    report.checks.push(`${name}: hidden below fold, real transform/opacity transition and desktop stagger`);

    for (const width of [320, 390, 700, 701, 900, 1100, 1101, 1280, 1440, 1920]) {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: width <= 700 ? 844 : 900 });
      await ready(page);
      assert.equal(await page.locator(target).count(), 24);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('h1').count(), 1);
      assert.equal(await page.locator(pending).count() > 0, true, 'offscreen content waits for scroll');
      await sweep(page);
      const items = await visibleSnapshot(page);
      assert(items.every((item) => item.opacity === '1' && item.transform === 'none'));
      if (width <= 700) assert(items.every((item) => item.delay === '0s'), 'no mobile stagger');
      assert(await page.evaluate(() => window.__motionObservers.filter((o) => o.about).every((o) => o.active.size === 0)), 'observer released all targets');
      const starts = await page.evaluate(() => window.__motionStarts.length);
      await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: document.documentElement.scrollHeight, behavior: 'instant' }));
      await page.waitForTimeout(100);
      await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' }));
      await page.waitForTimeout(120);
      assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => window.__motionStarts.length), starts, 'no replay on repeated scrolling');
      const layout = await page.evaluate(() => ({ width: innerWidth, scrollWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, clientWidth: document.documentElement.clientWidth, height: document.documentElement.scrollHeight }));
      report.layouts.push({ browser: name, ...layout });
      if ([390, 900, 1440].includes(width)) await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${name}-about-${width}.png`), fullPage: true });
      report.checks.push(`${name}: all 24 targets reveal once, no overflow, final geometry at ${width}px`);
    }

    const starts = await page.evaluate(() => window.__motionStarts.length);
    for (const width of [390, 900, 1440, 320, 1101]) {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 900 });
      await page.waitForTimeout(100);
      const items = await visibleSnapshot(page);
      assert(items.every((item) => item.opacity === '1' && item.transform === 'none'));
      assert.equal(await page.locator(pending).count(), 0);
    }
    assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => window.__motionStarts.length), starts);
    report.checks.push(`${name}: completed reveals never restart or move across breakpoints`);

    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 900 });
    await ready(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.service-areas__content').getAttribute('data-about-reveal-state'), 'pending');
    await page.locator('.service-areas__content a').evaluate((el) => el.focus({ preventScroll: true }));
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.service-areas__content').getAttribute('data-about-reveal-state'), 'static');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.service-areas__content').evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity), '1');
    report.checks.push(`${name}: keyboard focus reveals a hidden link immediately`);

    await ready(page);
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
    await page.waitForFunction(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.about-page [data-about-reveal]')].every((el) => el.dataset.aboutRevealState === 'static'));
    await finish(page);
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'no-preference' });
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-about-reveal-state="static"]').count(), 24);
    assert.equal(await page.locator(pending).count(), 0);
    report.checks.push(`${name}: live Reduced Motion finishes all transitions without subsequent replay`);

    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' });
    await ready(page);
    assert.equal(await page.locator(target).count(), 0, 'initial reduced motion skips enhancement');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.our-values__card').first().evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity), '1');
    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'no-preference' });
    assert.equal(await page.locator(target).count(), 0);
    report.checks.push(`${name}: initial Reduced Motion leaves all content static and visible`);

    await ready(page);
    await page.emulateMedia({ media: 'print' });
    assert((await visibleSnapshot(page)).every((item) => item.opacity === '1' && item.transform === 'none'));
    await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('beforeprint')));
    await page.emulateMedia({ media: 'screen' });
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-about-reveal-state="static"]').count(), 24);
    report.checks.push(`${name}: print stylesheet and beforeprint expose all content`);

    await ready(page, 'http://127.0.0.1:4193/about');
    assert.equal(await page.locator(target).count(), 24);
    assert.equal(await page.locator('.our-values__card').first().getAttribute('data-about-reveal-state'), 'pending');
    await sweep(page);
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Contact Our Team', exact: true }).click();
    await page.waitForURL('**/contact');
    await page.locator('.contact-page').waitFor();
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-about-reveal]').count(), 0);
    assert(await page.evaluate(() => window.__motionObservers.filter((o) => o.about).every((o) => o.active.size === 0)));
    await page.goBack();
    await page.locator('.about-page').waitFor();
    assert.equal(await page.locator(target).count(), 24);
    report.checks.push(`${name}: React StrictMode, route cleanup, Contact link and browser Back`);

    await ready(page);
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Explore Our Work', exact: true }).click();
    await page.waitForURL('**/gallery');
    await page.locator('.gallery-page').waitFor();
    assert(await page.evaluate(() => window.__motionObservers.filter((o) => o.about).every((o) => o.active.size === 0)), 'unmount with pending targets disconnects');
    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-about-reveal]').count(), 0);
    for (const route of ['/services', '/blog']) {
      await page.goto(`${base}${route}`, { waitUntil: 'networkidle' });
      assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-about-reveal]').count(), 0);
      assert.equal(await page.locator('.page-hero__content').evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity), '1');
    }
    report.checks.push(`${name}: pending-observer cleanup and no effects on other shared-Hero pages`);

    const fallback = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } });
    await fallback.addInitScript(() => { window.IntersectionObserver = undefined; });
    const fallbackPage = await fallback.newPage();
    await ready(fallbackPage);
    assert.equal(await fallbackPage.locator(target).count(), 0);
    assert.equal(await fallbackPage.locator('.our-values__card').first().evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).opacity), '1');
    await fallback.close();
    report.checks.push(`${name}: unavailable IntersectionObserver fails open`);

    // Verify the precise trigger threshold independently of real viewport timing.
    const thresholdContext = await browser.newContext({ reducedMotion: 'no-preference' });
    await thresholdContext.addInitScript(() => {
      window.__fakeObserver = null;
      window.IntersectionObserver = class {
        constructor(callback, options) { this.callback = callback; this.options = options; this.nodes = new Set(); window.__fakeObserver = this; }
        observe(node) { this.nodes.add(node); }
        unobserve(node) { this.nodes.delete(node); }
        disconnect() { this.nodes.clear(); }
      };
    });
    const thresholdPage = await thresholdContext.newPage();
    await ready(thresholdPage);
    await thresholdPage.waitForFunction(() => window.__fakeObserver?.nodes.size === 24);
    for (const ratio of [0.14, 0.15]) {
      await thresholdPage.evaluate((value) => window.__fakeObserver.callback([{ target: document.querySelector('.our-values__card'), isIntersecting: true, intersectionRatio: value, boundingClientRect: { bottom: 300 } }]), ratio);
      assert.equal(await thresholdPage.locator('.our-values__card').first().getAttribute('data-about-reveal-state'), ratio < 0.15 ? 'pending' : 'visible');
    }
    assert.equal(await thresholdPage.evaluate(() => window.__fakeObserver.nodes.size), 23);
    await thresholdContext.close();
    report.checks.push(`${name}: 14% waits, 15% reveals and immediately unobserves target`);

    const touch = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, hasTouch: true, isMobile: true, reducedMotion: 'no-preference' });
    const phone = await touch.newPage();
    await ready(phone);
    await sweep(phone);
    await phone.getByRole('link', { name: 'Contact Our Team', exact: true }).tap();
    await phone.waitForURL('**/contact');
    await phone.locator('.contact-page').waitFor();
    await touch.close();
    report.checks.push(`${name}: touch viewport reveal sweep and Contact tap`);
    assert.deepEqual(runtimeErrors, [], 'no page runtime errors');
    report.checks.push(`${name}: no runtime errors during all motion scenarios`);
  } catch (error) {
    report.failures.push({ browser: name, message: String(error), stack: error.stack, runtimeErrors });
    try { await page.screenshot({ path: path.join(out, `${name}-failure.png`) }); } catch {}
  } finally {
    await context.close();
    await browser.close();
    await fs.writeFile(path.join(out, 'report.json'), JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
  }
}
console.log(JSON.stringify({ checks: report.checks.length, layouts: report.layouts.length, failures: report.failures }, null, 2));
if (report.failures.length) process.exitCode = 1;
